besanconcitadel.name: Besançon Citadel
besanconcitadel.slogan: Vauban's walls above a river bend, still standing guard.
besanconcitadel.line: Its walls are 15 to 20 metres high, and a well was cut 132 metres through the rock.

arcsenanssaline.name: Royal Saltworks, Arc-et-Senans
arcsenanssaline.slogan: A factory drawn as an ideal city, in a perfect half circle.
arcsenanssaline.line: Ledoux's first plan was a square; the king rejected it, and work began in 1775 on the semicircle.

ronchampchapel.name: Ronchamp Chapel
ronchampchapel.slogan: Le Corbusier's white hilltop sculpture with a roof like a sail.
ronchampchapel.line: Blessed in 1955 and consecrated in 2005, it joined the UNESCO list in 2016 with Le Corbusier's other works.

besanconclock.name: Astronomical Clock
besanconclock.slogan: Thousands of moving parts keeping time inside the cathedral.
besanconclock.line: Auguste-Lucien Vérité built it in 1858–60: some 30,000 parts drive its 122 indications.

ornanscourbet.name: Courbet's Ornans
ornanscourbet.slogan: Cliffs, river and the painter's own town, house by house.
ornanscourbet.line: Burial at Ornans was in reality the burial of romanticism.
ornanscourbet.by: Gustave Courbet, on A Burial at Ornans
